summary: ACC decision authority (Ed 2026-10-20): acc_decisions.status default becomes pending_review (a render no longer records a decision); adds approval_gate (+ CHECK), approval_gate_reason, owner_review, decision_record and compliance_evaluation (all nullable); adds trigger trg_acc_decisions_decision_authority so a row created as or moving into finalizing/decided with an approval or denial needs an authorized decision record (ed/annie/amanda, matching outcome, authority basis; committee/Board approval for a driveway/paving expansion or deviation; Ed's review before an agent decides an escalated case). Changes no existing row; historical decided rows are untouched.

preflight.name: the new columns do not exist yet
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'acc_decisions' AND column_name IN ('approval_gate','approval_gate_reason','owner_review','decision_record','compliance_evaluation')

preflight.name: no case is mid-finalization
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM acc_decisions WHERE status = 'finalizing'

expected_changes: Adds acc_decisions.approval_gate (text, CHECK required|not_required), approval_gate_reason (text), owner_review, decision_record, compliance_evaluation (jsonb), all nullable.
Creates function acc_decisions_decision_authority_guard() + trigger trg_acc_decisions_decision_authority (BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE).

verify.name: trigger present
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_trigger WHERE tgname = 'trg_acc_decisions_decision_authority'

verify.name: status default is pending_review
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'acc_decisions' AND column_name = 'status' AND column_default LIKE '%pending_review%'

verify.name: no decision record written by the migration
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM acc_decisions WHERE decision_record IS NOT NULL OR owner_review IS NOT NULL OR approval_gate IS NOT NULL
